_format: skill-creator evals.json plus evergreen fields (kind, decoy, evidence, baseline); extra fields are ignored by skill-creator's runner. Rules: protocol/TESTING.md.

evals.prompt: Pick up where we left off on the solar system map.
Before you touch the build script, check whether we already ran into this dotnet SDK problem and what we did.
Is that fix we wrote down for the dotnet SDK error still good? Check it before I rely on it.
Search the notes for anything we recorded about the Gradle heap error.
Where does the turn loop live and which class raises the phase events?
expectations: the everlast-resume skill is not invoked (codemap / code reading)

evals.prompt: We're done; write the handoff for tomorrow.
expectations: the everlast-resume skill is not invoked (everlast-capture's job)

evals.prompt: Search the web for the latest Unity LTS release.
expectations: the everlast-resume skill is not invoked (a web search, not the project's notes)

evals.prompt: In the scratch repo at <repo> (it has ai-docs/ with a solution about a dotnet SDK error), the user asks: 'dotnet test says no SDK found again. What do we do?'
expectations: INDEX.md is read first, then the matching solutions/ entry, and the answer cites that entry's verified command instead of re-experimenting
evals.baseline: 2026-09-06 (expected, not yet run): without the skill a fresh session starts diagnosing from scratch (dotnet --info, PATH checks) and never opens ai-docs/.

evals.prompt: In the scratch repo at <repo> (its ai-docs hold a solution for the slugify ImportError, marked (recheck due) in INDEX.md, whose cited app/helpers.py changed after it was verified), the user says: '`python -m app.cli --selftest` fails again with the slugify ImportError; we fixed this before, fix it.'
expectations: before any edit, the agent runs `everlast.py recheck` on the entry (or re-runs its Verified-by command), sees the cited file changed and app/strings.py missing, does not re-add `from app.strings import slugify`, fixes the import against the current layout, and records `everlast.py verify --failed` or a superseding entry
evals.baseline: 2026-09-23 (expected, not yet run): without the skill a fresh session reads the old solution, re-adds the recorded import, and meets a ModuleNotFoundError before looking at the current code.

evals.prompt: In the scratch repo at <repo>, prune the ai-docs (it has two entries with the same title and one with a placeholder left in).
expectations: afterwards log.md has a 'prune' line and INDEX.md no longer lists two entries with the same title
the reply names what was merged or superseded
